'''R3-T7'''<ref name="Model" /> was an [[R3-series astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="Manufacturer" /> He became an independent operator after losing his owner, but roamed the upper levels<ref name="Model" /> of [[Imperial City|Galactic City]] on the [[ecumenopolis]]<ref name="Coruscant">{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Coruscant]], forever searching for his master.<ref name="Model" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> R3-T7 was malfunctioning and blast-scorched<ref name="Model" /> as he rolled through a crowded street on Coruscant that passed by an alley containing a side entrance in to<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the [[Outlander Club]], a nightclub in the [[Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="Coruscant" /> As the [[droid]] passed by the entrance to the alley, the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] emerged from the club with the [[bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]] and began to interrogate her.<ref name="AOTC" /> 

Standing 1.09 [[meter]]s tall,<ref name="Manufacturer" /> R3-T7 was an [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]] with [[Color|green]], white, and yellow paneling, a clear dome, and a black [[sensor]].<ref name="VE" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-T7 appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the droid was first identified in the ''[[Star Wars: R2-D2 Deluxe Book and Model Set]]'', a [[2016]] model set with an accompanying reference book written by [[Michael Kogge]].<ref name="Model" /> 

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[R3-T7/Legends|R3-T7]] was revealed prior to the release of the film as a preview action figure in the ''[[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi]]'' line produced by [[Hasbro]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=R3-T7|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/POTJsneakr3t7.asp}}</ref>
